ood.source: all T candidate G features, columns 0 through 7
ood.fallback: entire history uses the frozen independent N predictions
ood.report: raw and guarded predictions, choices and outcomes separately; retain every history

training_structure.direction_support: report all available and missing roles; require at least two marked directional roles per history as in acquisition contract

calibration_release: seal all four C paired prefix predictions before executing any C branch
stop_rules: retain all failures; no extension of alpha grid or outcome-dependent context/candidate replacement; do not open E after failed T/C gates
